cost.basis: Guest Groups page promises 'package rates that include lodging, delicious meals, meeting rooms' for groups of 20–200 but publishes no figures; the /camp-rates page returns 401 ('being updated'). Estimate uses the venue's own retail weekend programs as a proxy: Women's Weekend (Fri–Sun, 2 nights, all meals, program) is $340 standard cabin / $400 cabin with bathroom / $430 guest-house room per person, and Family Camp says $550 for 3 nights 'reflects the actual cost of camp' (~$183/person/night). 60 x $340–430 = $20,400–25,800 for Fri–Sun with meals. Cabins are bunk dorms; guests bring bedding and towels.
cost.per_person: ~$340–430 per person for the weekend incl. meals (proxy from their own retail weekends)
cost.source_label: Westminster Woods Guest Group Rentals page (rates on inquiry)
cost.hint: Women's Weekend 2027 (Fri–Sun on site, meals included): $340 standard cabin, $400 cabin with bathroom, $430 guest house per person.

availability_notes: Hosts guest groups of 20–200. No group rentals in June–July; during the school year guest-group rentals are limited to weekends (Friday–Sunday) because of weekday school programs, so all nine Fri–Sun weekends are in principle eligible. No weddings except Nov–Mar; rarely family reunions. Lodging is mostly dorm cabins (8–10 bunks each) plus three 10–12-person guest houses and a few private-bath rooms; bring sleeping bags, pillows, towels. Inquiry via the group-inquiries form; no public availability calendar.

availability.evidence: Westminster Woods' own Family Camp (The Grove) Session 7 runs Fri 8/21–Mon 8/24 2026, and the summer-camp page states that during each program session 'we suspend all other rentals and uses of the facility'.
